name: Four Seasons Istanbul, Sultanahmet
insider_take: This former Ottoman prison has been transformed into Istanbul's most prestigious address, where history whispers through marble corridors and the call to prayer drifts from the Blue Mosque next door.
whats_special: Built as a 19th-century neoclassical courthouse and prison, this Four Seasons occupies one of the world's most historically significant hotel sites. The building once held political prisoners, including writers and intellectuals, before its stunning conversion preserved original architectural details like vaulted ceilings and stone walls. You're literally sleeping where Ottoman justice once ruled.
pro_tip: Request a room facing the courtyard to enjoy the peaceful garden oasis, or splurge on a Bosphorus view suite to watch ships navigate between Europe and Asia from your window.
dont_miss: The hotel sits in the heart of Sultanahmet, just steps from Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, and Topkapi Palace. The underground Basilica Cistern is a 2-minute walk, and the Grand Bazaar's 4,000 shops are easily reachable on foot. The rooftop terrace offers unparalleled views of the Golden Horn and Old City's UNESCO World Heritage skyline.
pros: Prime location in historic Sultanahmet district near major attractions
Converted Ottoman prison building with unique architectural heritage
Exceptional Four Seasons luxury service and amenities
Beautiful courtyard and gardens providing peaceful retreat
cons: Historic building may have smaller room sizes
